use_cases: Displaying and adjusting numeric values with increment/decrement controls
Quantity selector for e-commerce product pages or shopping carts
Simple numeric input interface for forms requiring stepper-style input
Counter for tracking simple metrics or statistics
Basic numeric input for settings panels or configuration interfaces
ai_summary: A minimalist atomic counter component with increment and decrement buttons for manipulating numeric values. Features React useState for simple local state management, displaying the current count in a clean centered layout. Uses flat visual styling with basic Tailwind classes for a lightweight, dependency-free implementation suitable for any platform.
